title: Control Structure Core
mission: Expose the control structure of this world by mapping public records, institutions, money rails, access systems, disclosure gaps, elite influence, and missing records.
boundary: The site separates evidence, public reporting, documented association, hypothesis, and unsupported claim. It exposes structure through records and source routes, not unsupported accusation.

layers.name: Money and reserves
layers.question: Who controls money, reserves, payment rails, debt, custody and settlement systems?

layers.name: Identity and access
layers.question: Which systems decide who can access services, money, movement, platforms or public life?

layers.name: Information and narrative
layers.question: Who shapes what people are allowed to know, say, search, believe or remember?

layers.name: Security and emergency power
layers.question: Which emergency, intelligence, border, cyber and policing systems expand authority?

layers.name: Elite networks and institutions
layers.question: Which people, families, companies, foundations, forums and institutions sit across multiple control layers?

layers.name: Disclosure and black files
layers.question: What records are missing, redacted, sealed, delayed or explained away?

layers.name: Speculation review
layers.question: Which dark claims are testable leads, and which are unsupported noise?

currentConclusion: The control structure is best exposed by mapping dependency: money, identity, information, emergency power, infrastructure, elite networks, and missing records. The question is not only who is powerful; it is which systems ordinary life depends on and who controls those rails.
nextAction: Make the homepage and Matrix Brain route every visitor through this control map, then upgrade search so users can find the right layer instantly.
